ledger.x: 1125: the Republic of Siena is founded.
1260: Montalcino becomes a satellite of Siena.
1286: the government of the Nine (Nove) takes over Siena.
1547: Spain holds Siena through a governor.
17 July 1552: the Sienese expel the Spanish garrison and take a French one.
January 1554: Florence and Spain besiege Siena.
3 February 1555: Massa Marittima is incorporated by the Medici state.
April 1555: the siege ends with the fall of Siena.
1555: exiled loyalists reconstitute the Republic at Montalcino.

wars.name: Battle of Montaperti
wars.outcome: On 4 September 1260 the Sienese Ghibellines defeated the Florentine Guelphs; the page gives no border change.

wars.name: Italian War of 1551-1559
wars.outcome: Siena revolted against Spain on 17 July 1552, was beaten at Marciano (2 August 1554), fell after an 18-month siege in April 1555 and its Montalcino rump was annexed under the Treaty of Cateau-Cambresis (3 April 1559).
